None of the seven chosen is among them. Seed mapping (variants.ts): build = BUILDS[s%5] (chibi, heroic, bulky, child, tall), rest = RESTS[s%3] (T, A, relaxed), naming = NAMINGS[s%4] (vrm, mixamo, ue5, rigify), twist = floor(s/4)%2 === 1, drop = DROPS[s%6] ([], upperChest, toes, shoulders, neck, chest+upperChest); lengths x0.96-1.04 per seed. Because s%6 fixes both s%2 and s%3, the dropped bones set the rest pose (drop index mod 3), and the naming's parity must match the drop's: vrm/ue5 go with none/toes/neck, mixamo/rigify with upperChest/shoulders/chest+upperChest. I picked each seed as the first unused one meeting the planned combination after an arbitrary start (2311, 3517, 4729, 5903, 6151, 7369, 8543). Spread: builds tall x2 (B1, B6), bulky x2 (B2, B7), child (B3), chibi (B4), heroic (B5); rests A x2, relaxed x2, T x3; namings mixamo 1, ue5 2, rigify 2, vrm 2 (B4 and B7); twist bones on 3 (B2 UE5 leaves, B3 Rigify in-chain, B4 VRM leaves); left out: upperChest, toes, shoulders, neck, chest+upperChest, none x2. Every fact in the briefs was checked by generating each seed (character(variant(seed))), loading it with loadGlb (textures: false) and binding it (bind from @m3a/three): bind recognised all seven by table with confidence 1, nothing missing and no issues, with the rest kind and arm drop expected. H0 equals the hips bone's height above the mesh's lowest point (the soles), so the briefs give the 'hips above the soles' figure from H0 (1.26, 1.05, 0.695, 0.45, 1.04, 1.23, 1.10 m) and the height as the mesh's span. Things to watch: (1) the briefs give bone names as they are in the glTF file; three.js's GLTFLoader drops ':' and '.' from node names (mixamorig:Hips loads as mixamorigHips, DEF-spine.001 as DEF-spine001), which the briefs don't mention. (2) B4 keeps a VRM-named avatar as its contract requires (the starter check finds the hips by /hips|pelvis/i). Its body is the smallest chibi build (H0 445.5 mm), the most extreme of the seven: the gate's known-good check on the variant is where any trouble would show. (3) B3's child (H0 695 mm) has no shoulder bones and Rigify twist bones inside the arm and leg chains. (4) B1's speeds.json for H0 1262 should be about 26% above the 1 m figures (by the grader's scriptFor: 0, 1.51, 4.42, 1.51, 0 m/s); the brief says only 'proportionally more' and gives no numbers.
